title: Decomposability-Guided Cooperative Coevolution for Large-Scale Itinerary Planning
abstract: arXiv:2506.06121v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large-scale itinerary planning is a variant of the traveling salesman problem, aiming to determine an optimal path that maximizes the collected point-of-interest (POI) scores while minimizing travel time and cost, subject to travel duration constraints. This paper analyzes inter-component dependence in large-scale itinerary planning and establishes sufficient conditions for weak decomposability, under which an optimal path can visit each cluster as a contiguous subpath. Guided by this weak decomposability, we propose a novel multi-objective cooperative coevolutionary algorithm for large-scale itinerary planning, addressing the challenges of component imbalance and interactions. Specifically, we design a dynamic decomposition strategy based on the normalized fitness within each component, define optimization potential considering component scale and contribution, and develop a computational resource allocation strategy. translated_title: 可分解性引导的大规模行程规划协同进化算法
translated_abstract: 大规模行程规划是旅行商问题的一种变体，旨在确定一条最优路径，在满足旅行时长约束的条件下，最大化收集的兴趣点（POI）得分，同时最小化旅行时间和成本。本文分析了大规模行程规划中组件间的依赖关系，并建立了弱可分解性的充分条件，在该条件下，最优路径可以将每个簇作为连续的子路径进行访问。在这种弱可分解性的指导下，我们提出了一种新颖的大规模行程规划多目标协同进化算法，以应对组件不平衡和组件间相互作用的挑战。具体而言，我们设计了一种基于每个组件内归一化适应度的动态分解策略，定义了考虑组件规模和贡献的优化潜力，并开发了一种计算资源分配策略。
tldr: 本文通过分析大规模行程规划中的弱可分解性条件，提出了一种多目标协同进化算法，利用动态分解策略和计算资源分配策略有效解决了组件不平衡与相互作用的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes sufficient conditions for weak decomposability in large-scale itinerary planning and proposes a multi-objective cooperative coevolutionary algorithm with dynamic decomposition and computational resource allocation strategies to address component imbalance and interactions.
